channel.description: Latest articles from Boulder Daily Camera (dailycamera.com)

item.title: Federal judge extends order protecting refugees in Minnesota from being arrested and deported
item.description: The order applies only in Minnesota.

item.title: Injured mother manatee and calf are rescued in Florida and taken to SeaWorld
item.description: At least six manatees were rescued because of cold stress, watercraft injuries and malnutrition.

item.title: Treasury Department terminates union contracts for IRS and Bureau of the Fiscal Service workers
item.description: Workers at the Bureau of the Fiscal Service are also affected.

item.title: Los Angeles school superintendent placed on paid leave amid federal probe
item.description: Carvalho, who became superintendent in 2022, previously led the public schools in Miami.

item.title: Sleepy owl found resting among items on a New York antique store shelf
item.description: Customers at The Market Place had spotted “something extremely lifelike” on one of the shelves.

item.title: With only 3 women left, an Amazon tribe faced extinction. An unexpected birth now brings hope
item.description: Three women lived for years as the last members of the Akuntsu people.

item.title: Former Hygiene Fire captain gets 55 years to life in prison for sexually assaulting multiple women
item.description: Kamron Barnaby was sentenced Friday to 55 years to life in prison for sexually assaulting five women, two of whom were teenagers, during his time at Hygiene Fire.

item.title: Longmont community members will teach life skills at annual fair
item.description: On Sunday, the third annual Life Skills Fair will teach practical, career and wellness tips to young people.

item.title: Longmont boys basketball falters in 5A second round game against Golden
item.description: In the immediate aftermath of Longmont boys basketball's 59-42 home Class 5A state tournament loss against Golden, a parade of huge awaited its players amid the general hush in the gym.

item.title: Centaurus boys basketball sees bigger picture in season-ending loss to Cherry Creek
item.description: A 31-6 halftime deficit. On the road. Against bracket's 6-seed? There was no recovering from that as the 27th-ranked Warriors' season ended in a thud at Cherry Creek, 53-23.
